newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan watchdog starts probe into Suzutan - NHK.
newsitem.headline: Japan watchdog starts probe into Suzutan - NHK.

text.p: Japan's securities watchdog has launched an investigation into Suzutan Co Ltd, the NHK public television network reported on Monday.
A company spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
Suzutan is a women's wear retailer.
Officials at the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC) were also not immediately available to comment on the report.
NHK said president Katsurao Suzui, then chairman of the company, sold one million shares of his company before the company announced a 6.6 billion yen loss in October 1994.
Following the loss announcement, shares in the company, which are listed on the first section of Tokyo Securities Exchange, plunged to around 900 yen from 1,300 yen, NHK reported.
